messages:
maya: Hey team — EuroPac (EU fintech) needs SOC 2 + ISO27001 artifacts, a signed pen-test confirmation letter, and confirmation we can allow a one-week auditor review (read-only logs). This is blocking their PO for a Dedicated POC. Can we assemble and sign today?
liam: Got it. Quick Qs: exact ISO artifacts (cert vs scope doc), preferred pen-test wording, and who signs from their side?
maya: They need the ISO certificate PDF and the scope annex (they specifically call out data center and VPC controls). For pen-test letter they asked for a signed attestation on scope + no-production-exfil clause. Contact is nadia@europac.com.
nana: @ana here (security). We have a standard pen-test attestation template but need to confirm scope lines up with their ask. Also need to know if they require HSM/KMS key access or full log export.
liam: I can prepare a sanitized evidence bundle (config snippets, SOC 2 test evidence zip, ISO cert PDF, network diagram). I'll redact IPs and customer identifiers. Preview list:
```
- SOC2: control matrix + 3 sample test run screenshots
- ISO27001: cert.pdf + scope-annex.pdf
- Pen-test: vendor report summary (if available) + signed attestation template
- Ops: token rotation & KMS integration docs
```
maya: Deadline from EU Pac: they want to review by EOD tomorrow CET. Can legal countersign the pen-test letter?
jon: Jon (legal). I can counter-sign but need the final draft routed to legal@redwood.ai. Expect 24 hours review. If customer wants additional legal language (NDA references, liability caps) we'll need more time.
eli: Sales-ops — pricing note: for Dedicated POC we can offer a temporary 25% reserved-capacity credit for a 3-month commit. If they want only Hosted short POC, we can apply $10k credit instead. Which path are we targeting?
maya: They're leaning Dedicated (predictable latency). Use the 25% option as negotiation leverage.
nana: Security question: auditor read-only access — we can provide RBAC-limited S3/Log access for 7 days and streamlines for disk snapshots. We typically retain detailed logs 90 days; can we confirm 90d is acceptable? Also, pen-test letter: we won't disclose raw exploit POC details, only high-level findings + remediation status.
liam: Uploading initial sanitized bundle now. Link: https://drive.internal/rw/evidence/europac-poc-v1 (preview). Pen-test attestation draft uploaded as `pen_test_attestation_v1.docx`.
drive-bot: Evidence bundle uploaded by liam: https://drive.internal/rw/evidence/europac-poc-v1 — viewers: maya, liam, ana, jon, eli.
maya: Thanks. I'll loop in the customer and request a provisional acceptance window. @jon please confirm once countersigned so I can send final to nadia.
jon: Will do. Routing to legal now. If they require audit on-site or full disk access we need a formal SOW.
liam: FYI — quick checklist I'm sending to the customer with the bundle: 1) ISO cert + annex, 2) SOC 2 evidence index, 3) pen-test attestation (signed), 4) log access instructions, 5) POC pricing/credit sheet.
maya: Perfect. I'll attach the pricing/credit sheet to the PO request. Thanks all :thumbsup:
